audit.whatIsWrong: All seven level-chart sides contradicted the packet chart, and five of them contradicted their own why text on the same row.
audit.why: Packet levelChart: Renekton, Skill, Renekton, Gragas, Gragas, Gragas, Gragas. Stored sides were Skill, Renekton, Renekton, Skill, Skill, Renekton, Renekton. The content whys already match the packet exactly — whys[0] 'concede the level', whys[1] 'it's a coinflip', whys[2] 'give ground', whys[3] 'the lane tips here', whys[4]/[5]/[6] all Gragas — so only the enums were wrong.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Renekton / Skill / Renekton / Gragas / Gragas / Gragas / Gragas in both layers, with ratings moved to match, as one atomic group.

audit.whatIsWrong: Ruthless Predator is called 'a long stun' everywhere with no numbers, and the Fury threshold that creates it is never stated as a threshold you can read off his bar.
audit.why: Riot text: 'Renekton slashes his target twice... stuns them for 0.75 seconds. If Renekton has more than 50 Fury, he slashes his target three times, destroying damage shields on the target, dealing high physical damage, and stunning them for 1.5 seconds.' Cooldown 16/14/12/10/8s. That is the whole matchup — 0.75s is survivable, 1.5s is his full combo, and his Fury bar tells you which one you are about to eat.
audit.corrected: Read the Fury bar: empty means 0.75s and a trade you can take, 50+ means 1.5s and you do not walk up. Fight on the 16s cooldown at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty 6/10 against a 54.68% Emerald+ win rate over 587 games with Gragas winning four of seven stages.
audit.why: The packet gives Gragas Levels 4-5 onward outright, and Renekton has no scaling. The lane is his for three levels and yours for the rest.
audit.corrected: Difficulty set to 5/10, framed as surviving the Fury window rather than tracking one cooldown all game.

audit.why: Ruthless Predator 16/14/12/10/8s, Slice and Dice 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s, Body Slam 14/13.5/13/12.5/12s. Early on, his two key cooldowns are both 16s — that is a long punish window at levels 4-5, and it shrinks to 8s and 10s by rank 5, which is why the window has to be used early.
audit.corrected: Cooldown block rewritten with the real numbers.

audit.why: Cull the Meek heals Renekton for a portion of damage dealt and the heal scales up above 50 Fury, so the existing Executioner's Calling recommendation in report[8] is right and was left alone.

edits.before: Bait his empowered W — E-Q burst and disengage. Gragas wins by trading around Renekton's Ruthless Predator and cashing the pattern: bait his stun and burst him with E-Q.
edits.after: Read his Fury bar: Ruthless Predator stuns 0.75s empty and 1.5s at 50+. It is 16s at rank 1, so once it is spent step in with E-Q and let Happy Hour eat the trade.

edits.before: Bait his stun and burst him with E-Q. Track Ruthless Predator before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Survive his Fury window, then fight on Ruthless Predator's 16-second cooldown with Happy Hour healing behind you.

edits.before: Q-poke Renekton on cooldown from fog angles, W as he answers, and E-slam only when his key tool is down.
edits.after: Barrel Roll poke while his Fury bar is empty, W-auto his step-up, Body Slam once Ruthless Predator is spent.

edits.before: Body-slamming INTO his answer — a whiffed E is 13 seconds of being a barrel with no plan.
edits.after: Walking up on a full Fury bar — empowered W is 1.5s point-click and his Q heals it all back.

edits.before: Empowered = long stun. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 0.75s empty, 1.5s at 50+ Fury, 16s at rank 1. Fight after it is spent.

edits.before: Q-poke Renekton on cooldown from fog angles, W as he answers, and E-slam only when his key tool is down.
edits.after: Poke with Barrel Roll while his Fury bar is empty, then commit E-Q the moment Ruthless Predator is spent.

edits.before: Renekton wastes Ruthless Predator (Stun) — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Ruthless Predator spent means 16 seconds of a Renekton who cannot stun you.

edits.before: That is Renekton's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: A full Fury bar is his entire all-in window — refuse it and his lane phase is gone.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Empowered W is 1.5 seconds — long enough for his whole combo.

edits.before: Body-slamming INTO his answer — a whiffed E is 13 seconds of being a barrel with no plan.
edits.after: Level 3 is his — empowered W plus Slice and Dice out-damage your unmaxed combo.

edits.before: - Renekton Ruthless Predator: matchup-defining — Empowered = long stun. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Ruthless Predator: 16/14/12/10/8s — a 0.75s stun, 1.5s at 50+ Fury. - Slice and Dice: 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s, his way in and back out. - Body Slam, 14s at rank 1: spend it only once his W is gone.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 6/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Ruthless Predator and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 5/10. The lane is decided by whether you survive his Fury window without spending Body Slam.

edits.before: Track Renekton's Ruthless Predator (Stun): Empowered = long stun. Bait it. When it is down — E-Q burst him.
edits.after: Ruthless Predator stuns 0.75s empty and 1.5s at 50+ Fury, on 16s at rank 1. Once spent — E-Q burst him.

edits.before: Even matchup — difficulty 6/10, Renekton carry threat 7/10.
edits.after: Even matchup — difficulty 5/10, Renekton carry threat 7/10.

edits.before: Q-poke from range wins level 1 outright. Identify how Renekton contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Level 1 is his: empowered W is point-click and Cull the Meek heals him off you before any sustain exists.

edits.before: W damage reduction + sustain flips his return trade. Only take the trade when Renekton's Ruthless Predator is down.
edits.after: Level 2 is a coinflip — your W-auto sustain trade against his Fury stun, decided by who lands first.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Renekton must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Level 3 is his: empowered W plus Slice and Dice out-damage an unmaxed combo on long cooldowns — give ground and farm.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Ruthless Predator's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: The lane tips to you here: W max and Happy Hour heal back his Fury trades, and his bar runs dry far faster than your cooldowns do.

edits.before: Explosive Cask both finishes kills and deletes engages — you choose the fight. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Renekton's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Level 6 is yours: Q-cask, E stun, W-empowered auto, then detonate — Explosive Cask knocks him into your tower with his Fury already spent.

edits.before: Riftmaker is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Ruthless Predator's cooldown.
edits.after: First item is your peak — force the all-in on his 16-second Ruthless Predator cooldown.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Renekton carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Renekton has no scaling at all: two items in, your sustain and burst keep growing while his Fury window is long behind him.

notes: Content layer was already accurate here — the whys, spikes and prose all named the right abilities and matched the packet chart. The damage was entirely in the full layer, whose level-chart enums were inverted against both the packet and the content layer, and whose prose was the generic template with no numbers. Added the 0.75s / 1.5s Fury-threshold stun split and the 16s cooldown, which is the one thing a Gragas player needs to read off Renekton's bar. Note for the user: report[8] recommends Executioner's Calling and that stands — Cull the Meek heals off you and the heal grows above 50 Fury.
